vectors.name: valid
vectors.note: A calculated run, signed, witnessed and bound, as Runner exported it (version 5). Its source is a calculator that computed, so its lineage carries a calculation and its freshness was judged by acquisition and by table. The record carries the binding Runner passed, whose digest is preparation.sha256: the SHA-256 of preparation.json, which is the preparation the Runner computes from mapping.json, case.json, sources.json and profiles.json at verifiedAt. A reader holding the record's binding to the preparation concludes that they match.

vectors.name: recomputed-one-second-later
vectors.note: preparation.json is what the Runner computes at the later instant, and the export retains it: every check of the inputs passes, and freshness is still within its limits. vectors.altered: The export's preparation is recomputed one second later: its verifiedAt, and the runAt each outcome retains among its parameters. The record, its signature and its chain entry are as they were.

vectors.name: escaped-strings
vectors.note: A case-only run, as Runner exported it (version 2), before it passed a binding: every target is asserted, and nothing was acquired. A case value holds &, <, >, a letter with an accent and a snowman, so preparation.json shows the canonical form's escaping: &, < and > escaped as \u0026, \u003c and \u003e, the others written as UTF-8.

vectors.name: numeric-spellings
vectors.note: The valid case's mapping and inputs, run again with three integer case parameters more, which nothing reads: zero written -0, largest 9007199254740991 and least -9007199254740991, the largest and the least integers mapping v2 admits. Each outcome keeps them among its parameters as the case wrote them, and so does preparation.json: -0 is not 0, and neither large integer is written with an exponent. Numbers such as 1.00 and 1e+02, and integers beyond 2^53-1, are outside what mapping v2 admits (integers from -(2^53-1) to 2^53-1, with no fraction or exponent): preparation refuses them as a parameter and as a copied value, so no preparation holds them and no vector can. A reader concludes verified-inputs, the record's binding matching the preparation as written.
